findings.description: The code opens a file with inFile.open(argv[1]); but does not check if the file was successfully opened before reading from it.
The loop while (!inFile.eof()) is not the correct way to read a file. This can lead to reading the last line twice or reading invalid data.
The code assumes that all words in the word bank and user input are of the same length, but does not check this before accessing strcomp[i] or word[i].
The code does not validate user input for the starting and final words, nor does it check if they exist in the word bank.
The main loop in main() could potentially loop forever if the ladder cannot be found and ladder.size() keeps changing.
The variable past_size is initialized to -1, but if the ladder size is 0, the comparison may not work as intended.
